newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sandvik says eyeing U.S. listing.
newsitem.headline: Sandvik says eyeing U.S. listing.

text.p: Swedish specialty metals and toolmaker Sandvik on Thursday said it was eyeing a U.S. listing but said nothing particular was going on to would justify sharp gains in the share.
At 1500 GMT the share was trading up eight crowns at 180 amid smaller rises by other Swedish engineering shares.
"We are just as surprised at everyone else...Nothing exceptional is going on in the company," head of finance Gunnar Batelsson told Reuters.
He said he had not seen any new analysis of the company.
Asked about Sandvik buying back its own shares, a rumour market players said was pushing the share price higher, Batelsson said: "We have said we will consider the proposal when it comes up."
Batelsson did say, however, that the company was considering a U.S. listing.
"A number of Swedish companies have applied to be listed so naturally we who are not listed have considered it."
He said the company had not initiated any process to list the company.
